_about: Policy for select.js. Jev supplies probabilities; everything here is code-side and can change without re-running Jev. Nothing in this file has been tuned: there is no human-reviewed v4 data yet, and every gold/*.json list is Claude-drafted.
_act_about: act >= 0.70 turns a Noul into a tag; 0.40-0.70 is kept as level 'possible' (shown, never flags). AUDIT.md: labels at 0.5-0.7 were right 46% of the time, at 0.7+ 69%; the guardrails cookbook uses a 0.70 action threshold with a lower review band.
_overrides_about: Per-question exceptions keyed by question id, e.g. {"pl.shark": {"act": 0.85}}. Empty on purpose: an exception needs held-out evidence (a per-question threshold tuned on other films), and the only v4 data is a 6-scene fixture. AUDIT.md: per-attribute thresholds added about 3 F1 points in v2 and must be tuned leave-one-film-out.
_modifier_about: A scene-level modifier (retold, imagined, comic, child_in_trouble) is on at >= 0.70. It cancels events listed with cancel.<modifier> in questions.js, never presence.
_kind_about: Documented pattern (cookbooks/classification_using_confidence): confidence >= 0.9 -> trust the specific label; below -> report the parent level. Applies only to presence items with kindGate (monster_creature, shark, large_predator), and only when that item is already at act level.

presence_not_flags.deep_dark_water: Water is the setting of every scene of an ocean film. Danger in water is caught by the cannot_breathe and caught_in_hazard events; water alone is not a reason to skip.
presence_not_flags.darkness: Night or a dark room alone is not a scene to skip. What happens in the dark is caught by unseen_threat, jump_scare and chased. Still shown as a tag for parents who filter on it.
presence_not_flags.robot_machine_being: The robot is the friendly lead of The Iron Giant and The Wild Robot. A robot alone is not a warning; robot violence is caught by the events.

_friendly_about: Friendly presences such as a talking animal or a parent are not presence items at all; cast roles carry them. Every presence id in questions.js must appear in exactly one of parents_care_presence or presence_not_flags (checked in the tests).
_flag_about: A scene is flagged when any parents_care presence item or any event is at act level after modifiers and the kind gate. Mention-only, modifiers and scores never flag.

severity._about: Composite per age band (patterns/composite-scoring). Each Score is normalised to 0-1 (score / top level). base = weighted sum of the five Scores; content = max age-band weight (1-3, /3) among the scene's flagging tags; composite = (1 - content_weight) * base + content_weight * content, + child_in_trouble boost, then multiplied by the scale of every modifier that is on. Levels: < l1 -> 0 (none), < l2 -> 1, < l3 -> 2, else 3, matching the 1-3 scale of the current Sonnet severities. Uncalibrated starting values.
severity._weights_about: 5-7 weighs how frightened characters are and how long it lasts; 8-10 weighs real harm and whether it is resolved (ATTRIBUTES-RESEARCH.md: younger children react to peril and fear on screen, older ones to realistic harm and loss).
